name: overlay
description: Holds one child over the rest, centered, without pushing anything around; the parent is the box it covers.

attributes.name: data-fixed
attributes.description: Center the held child over the viewport instead of this box, and keep it there while the page scrolls.

attributes.name: data-gap
attributes.description: The least space kept between the held child and the edges of the box.

children.description: The content underneath, in normal flow, and one held child.
Exactly one child carries data-over; it leaves the flow and is centered over the box.

a11y.notes: Positioning only. The held child stays in reading order where it is in the source. A held child that interrupts the page needs focus management and a way to dismiss it, which the dialog and tooltip components provide; use those rather than this primitive alone for anything modal.
